a2ui.description: Allow the agent to drive A2UI mini-apps via the bridge MCP server.
a2ui.hint: When off, characters never see the mcp__a2ui-bridge__* tools by default. Per-mode overrides remain available in the Custom Mode editor.
a2ui.title: A2UI bridge

defaults.appendDesc: Appended to every default character's system prompt. Use sparingly — large appendices inflate token cost.
defaults.appendPlaceholder: e.g., 'Always reply in concise bullet points.'
defaults.bareModeHint: Skip on-disk auto-discovery (CLAUDE.md, hooks, plugins, MCP). Faster cold starts; the agent won't see your project's settings.
defaults.briefModeHint: Append a concise-output instruction to every send. Useful for chat triage and one-shot questions.
defaults.cacheOptDesc: Experimental. Re-layers the prompt so per-turn context (memory recall, twin chunks, goal/plan state) lands at the end, keeping the leading prefix stable across turns to maximize provider prompt-cache hits and cut input cost.
defaults.modelDesc: Used when neither the character nor the session pins a model.
defaults.modelEmpty: No providers configured. Add one in Settings → Providers.

outputStyle.customPlaceholder: Describe the response style you want (e.g. answer in a formal tone).
outputStyle.hint: Shape how the agent formats its replies. Composes with brief output.
outputStyle.label: Output style

defaults.permAuto: Auto — run most actions with background safety checks
defaults.permDontAsk: Don't ask — only pre-approved and read-only tools
defaults.permissionDesc: Default for new sessions — characters and individual sessions can still override.
defaults.planDesc: Defaults applied when a plan-mode turn proposes a plan (ExitPlanMode).
defaults.planInteractiveHtmlHint: Enhanced plan mode: review proposed plans in an interactive HTML editor — drag to reorder, edit inline, add or remove steps before approving.
defaults.planInteractiveStyleHint: Built-in visual preset for the interactive plan editor.
defaults.planMaxAutoRefinementsHint: Cap on automatic repair replans after a step failure (0–10).
defaults.planRequireApprovalHint: Show the approval card before implementing. When off, captured plans auto-resume in accept-edits mode.
defaults.routingDesc: When a turn fails, retry against the next entry in the alias's fallback chain. Disable to keep the original error visible.
defaults.thinkingActiveHint: Active: up to {budget} tokens reserved per turn for reasoning before the visible reply.
defaults.thinkingDesc: Tokens reserved for the SDK's extended-thinking pass. 0 disables thinking. Heads-up: streaming partial events are not emitted while a thinking budget is active.
defaults.thinkingDisabledHint: Off — Claude replies directly without an extended-thinking pass.
defaults.workingDirDesc: Sent to the sidecar as cwd. Useful when most chats target the same project.

description: Configure defaults for the in-process Claude SDK sidecar — these flow into every new chat unless a character or session overrides them.

permissions.alwaysAllowDesc: Tools listed here skip the per-call approval prompt for every chat.

autoMode.denyHighRiskHint: When the model rates a command high-risk, deny it instead of asking.
autoMode.desc: Automatically decide whether the agent's shell commands are safe to run, prompting only when uncertain.
autoMode.modeHint: Rules classify commands offline. Adding the model lets a cheap background model judge the ones the rules are unsure about.
autoMode.privacyNote: A command is sent to the model only when it contains no detected secrets or personal data.
autoMode.rulesDesc: Force a verdict for commands matching a glob — these override Auto-mode. Use a trailing * (e.g. git push*).
autoMode.title: Command Auto-mode

coreFiles.desc: grep / glob / read / edit / write / bash — the full file-tool suite for non-Anthropic models. Mutating tools require approval.
coreFiles.name: Core file tools

environment.desc: Read environment variables and system information. Secrets are redacted before they reach the agent.
environment.name: Environment

fileExtras.desc: Hash, structured diff, content search — beyond the SDK's built-in Read / Write / Edit.
fileExtras.name: File extras

git.desc: Structured wrappers around git_status, git_diff, git_log — easier on the agent than parsing raw shell output.
git.name: Git

lsp.desc: Language-server code intelligence: go to definition, references, hover, symbols, diagnostics.
lsp.name: LSP intelligence

process.desc: List, start, and terminate processes. High risk — only enable for trusted workflows.
process.name: Process

shellAdvanced.desc: Allowlist-gated single-program shell. Useful for project-specific build commands.
shellAdvanced.name: Shell (advanced)

terminalRepl.desc: Persistent interactive PTY sessions private to the agent (python / sql / REPLs).
terminalRepl.name: Terminal REPL

permissions.desktopOnlyHint: Built-in tool categories run inside the desktop sidecar — switch to the desktop app to enable them.

toolRules.bashSegmentHint: Shell rules match each command segment — author with trailing globs (e.g. git push*). Rules under Bash also govern the core bash tool.
toolRules.desc: Pin allow / ask / deny verdicts per tool and input pattern. Explicit rules skip the approval prompt; the third identical call still asks (loop guard).
toolRules.noRules: No tool rules yet — every gated call prompts for approval.
toolRules.patternPlaceholder: Input glob (path or command, e.g. src/**, git push*)
toolRules.previewDefault: No explicit rule matches — the default approval flow applies.
toolRules.previewPlaceholder: Test an input (e.g. git push origin, src/index.ts)
toolRules.title: Tool permission rules

sessions.deleteDesc: This permanently removes `{title}` and every message + usage row tied to it. The action can't be undone.
sessions.description: Every chat session, with token + USD totals captured from each turn's SDK result. Resume to switch the active chat; fork to branch off the SDK conversation; rename or delete in place.
sessions.emptyAll: No sessions yet. Start a chat to fill this list.
sessions.forkDisabledTip: Fork unavailable until the session has at least one completed turn.
sessions.renameDesc: Pick a new display title. Changing the title doesn't affect the chat history or SDK conversation.
sessions.title: Sessions

capabilities.description: What the live SDK session reports it supports. cognia's own model picker and slash menu are unaffected.
capabilities.title: Live session capabilities

sidecar.countsDescription: Live counts across the related Claude Code settings sections — click a tile to jump.
sidecar.description: Read-only view of the in-process Claude SDK sidecar.
sidecar.desktopOnlyHint: Restart is only available in the desktop build.
sidecar.title: Sidecar diagnostics

title: Built-in agent runtime

toolSearch.description: Load tools on demand to keep the system prompt small. Pin servers or tools below to keep them always available.
toolSearch.enableHelp: Tools are discovered on demand instead of all being injected up front.
toolSearch.serversHelp: These MCP servers stay resident and are never deferred.
toolSearch.title: Deferred tool loading
toolSearch.toolsHelp: These bare tool names stay resident and are never deferred.
toolSearch.unknownHint: Not found in the current tool catalog — this pin won't take effect until a matching server or tool exists.
